summary: Eviction suit based on possessory rights; agreement to sell with payment of consideration and possession memo sufficient for possessory title under Section 53A Transfer of Property Act; licencee occupation without proprietary rights; licence termination valid; power of attorney and will invalid for title transfer; Delhi HC precedents rejected as contrary to statutory law; dismissal of appeal confirmed; no error in mesne profits awarded at Rs.1000/month.
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; decree of eviction and mesne profits upheld.
